native_graphics_motion_audit.method: Original raw-token non-text controls; complete mathematical Form/clip/path membership and actual painted ink only.

source_math_internal_geometry.method: All original CambriaMath glyphs in each enclosed score-table formula cell retain their complete relative geometry; designated stationary table mathematics must additionally have zero horizontal movement.

native_script_motion_audit.scope: Read-only native scripts and reviewed complete expressions; source font/GID/size/y exact within numeric serialization tolerance

sibling_math_image_expression_geometry.method: Actual original/final Image Do CTM delta and every adjacent encoded native mathematical glyph share exactly one horizontal translation.

reviewed_inline_expression_geometry.method: Every source CID cluster and every original fraction rule of each reviewed complete inline expression must receive one common dx.

grading_columns_stationary.method: Independent source vertical cell primitives plus original top-level, non-prose numeric glyphs in the page right grading columns; every original grading glyph must remain at its source position.

original_input_outline_native_ink_audit.method: Original input glyph outlines with composed SVG ancestor transforms, shifted independently and rendered without text clips; reference<32 versus actual minRGB<220.
